theorem singletonTensorCech_coface_map_down
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2))
    (s : (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n) :
    let G := (Over.forget U).op ⋙
      (((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F)).obj)
    let P := ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 2) ↦ Over.mk g)
    let Q := ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g)
    let f := Pi.lift (fun k : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 2) ↦ Over.mk g) (j.succAbove k))
    (G.map f.op (Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 1 ↦ G.obj (op Q)) (fun _ ↦ 0) s)).down =
      Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F f.left
        ((Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 1 ↦
          AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1}
            Γ((Modules.tensorPullback Q.left.hom).obj F, ⊤))) (fun _ ↦ 0) s).down)

proof.text: Identify the lifted presheaf map at the opposite over-category arrow with AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.map of etaleTensorSectionsRestriction at its left arrow; this is the defining map equation of the opposite forgetful functor, sheafCompose and the tensor-section presheaf.

For an arbitrary additive section map r and a lifted map a equal to uliftFunctor.map r, compare the constant product projections by reflexivity, substitute a, and apply the generic ULift-down evaluation equation. Parameterize this calculation by the caller's Small instance for the index type, so the chosen categorical product and its projections use precisely the same smallness witness upon specialization.

Specialize the proved private calculation to I = Fin (n+1) → Fin 1, its constant-zero tuple, a = G.map f.op, and r = etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F f.left, using the defining map equation from the first step. This proves the displayed equation without changing any definition or public statement.
